settings.question: What products does Petssify sell?
settings.answer: Petssify offers practical pet supplies for cats and dogs, including toys, walking and training gear, grooming tools, feeding accessories, beds, comfort products, and travel essentials.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes! We offer international shipping at a flat rate of $6.99 for orders under $50, and FREE International Shipping on orders of $50 or more. Delivery typically takes 7–14 business days with tracking.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: All orders are processed within 1–2 business days after payment confirmation. United States shipping takes 5–10 business days ($3.99 flat or FREE on $50+). International delivery takes 7–14 business days. Every order includes a verified tracking number.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery. The item must be unused, unworn, in original condition and original packaging with proof of purchase. Approved refunds are credited to your original payment method within 5–7 business days.

settings.question: How do I know which product is right for my pet?
settings.answer: Each product page provides available specifications, sizing information, features, and usage details. Review these details carefully to choose the product that best fits your pet's needs.

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: Tracking information is emailed once your order ships. You can also use our order tracking page with the required order or tracking information. If your tracking information has not updated for several business days, contact our support team.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: Petssify accepts several payment methods, including major credit and debit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Shop Pay. Available payment options may vary at checkout.

settings.question: Do Petssify products have size or compatibility information?
settings.answer: Yes. When sizing or compatibility is relevant, the product page provides the available measurements, weight limits, dimensions, or other specifications to help you choose the appropriate product.

settings.question: What if my item arrives damaged or defective?
settings.answer: If you receive a damaged, defective, or incorrect item, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery at support@petssify.com with your order number and clear photos/video. We will arrange a free replacement or full refund.

settings.question: How can I contact Petssify customer support?
settings.answer: You can contact Petssify at support@petssify.com. Our support team typically responds within 24 hours.
